How much does it cost to run an outdoor security light?

A typical outdoor security light uses about 20 watts (10–50W depending on the model). Used for 1 hour per day, 7 days a week, it costs about 0.5p per day and £1.92 a year at the current price cap rate.

Cost per day
0.5p
About £1.92 a year at 1 hour per day, 7 days a week.

Standing charge not included.

Adjust for yours
Ofgem price cap average for 1 Oct – 31 Dec 2026 (standard variable tariff, Direct Debit, England, Scotland & Wales).

About these figures

Source for the typical figure: Typical range (estimate). See how we calculate.

Ways to cut the cost

  • Swap halogen and old-style bulbs for LEDs, which use around 80–90% less.
  • Use timers or smart plugs for decorative lighting.
  • Turn lights off in empty rooms.

Questions

How much does it cost to run an outdoor security light per hour?

At 26.32p/kWh, a 20W model costs about 0.5p an hour while it's running.

How much does it cost to run an outdoor security light per year?

About £1.92 a year, based on 1 hour per day, 7 days a week. Change the sliders above to match how you use yours.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my outdoor security light's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
